titulo: Coastal areas in England at risk of erosion to receive £11m in new funding
cuerpo: Exclusive: Laser-equipped drone surveys and road relocations among schemes to get government support Laser-equipped drone surveys, sand dune restoration and moving roads inland are among the projects that will receive government funding to help seaside communities in England adapt to rising seas and coastal erosion accelerated by climate breakdown . More than £11m will be shared between 12 council-led projects that will test ways to spot coastal change earlier and help communities plan for the effects. Continue reading...
